name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 8 - Am 108
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 8 a. Calls for the immediate suspension of the Green Deal, which contributes to undermining the competitiveness of Union enterprises, devastating agriculture, and weighing down the European economy in the context of globalisation;
